tellingsB.summary:
Read whole: twenty Lean statements and their three tellings; proofs not read. No telling was about something else, and none contradicts another. Records: 17 exact, 2 say less, 1 says more (a unit's positivity left to an earlier law). Docstrings: 16 exact, 2 say more (one dropped premise; one, "Where the continuation is open", reads general for a theorem of one named process), 1 says less, 1 absent. Chapters: 8 exact, 6 say less, 6 absent: the home often tells a sibling theorem and not the declaration sampled.

What this cannot show: twelve first declarations are definitions or helper lemmas, where little can go wrong; for four the record tells nothing, and I judged the theorem its statement is about. The headline theorems of most records were opened only in part. Definitions beneath statements were not all opened. One reader; twenty of 537; Chinese tellings unjudged but one.

overtakenFronts.headline: The twelve fronts were last hand-written on or before 13 November, before the direction page (15 Nov) and AGENTS.md's changed idea (16 Nov); none links the direction page. They contradict it at few places, chiefly one lock sentence and "the meta-attractor has closed and holds", copied across pages, and are silent on nearly all it added. By words, 53–100% of each page is untouched by the direction page, which in turn is silent on the fronts' ethics, theses and optimum line. Nothing was set against the Lean.

findings.finding: The fronts carry AGENTS.md's centre as it stood before 16 November. The lock sentence is flat on two pages: "where each step sets the selection again only from the share it already favours, the selection goes on the same way until what sustains it gives out, unless...", and the one page then says "These are theorems on stated models". AGENTS.md added the premise "and each such step adds to what is drawn from what sustains it, which does not grow without limit" on 16 Nov 22:06 (commit b16aec224); 0 of 12 fronts have it. Direction page: "the lock keeps an overdraw that stands and does not bring one about" (line 34); "a closed loop can go on without end where what it takes keeps being met" (line 62). The one page concedes this only in a later parenthesis.

metaAttractor.headline: The three homes name three different things. The folder: a civilisation-wide process where winning buys power over the rule, through minds and institutions. Chapter 02 and ClosedCapture: a two-level loop whose rule and reading are formed from the share, nothing beyond read. Ren on 18 November: an illusion held on to, a self within it, compounding destruction. Only the middle one has theorems; they state the lock and its outliving an unread loss. No theorem has a holder, an account that can be false, or a held-to that is not handed in. The direction page tells his picture without using the word.

findings.finding: Chapter 02's Definition is prose only: 'a loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share'. No Lean identifier carries the term; 'meta-attractor' appears only in the docstrings of 6 modules.
findings.howFarSeen: Chapter lines 398-465 read whole. Counted by grep: no match for MetaAttractor or 元吸引子 in the 406 files; 9 docstring lines in 6 files for 'meta-attractor'.

findings.finding: What the ClosedCapture theorems state: courses alike in share and rule stay alike exactly where nothing beyond the share is read (courses_alike_iff_unread, no other premise); a locked start stays locked while the loss passes every bound (lock_outlives_loss; premises Raises, ReadsShare, favouring kept upward, Accrues, a Locked start); a reading that favours at no loss past a bound unlocks (turned_by_loss); a changed reading formed again from the share is absorbed (reading_absorbed). Nothing is derived to grow: the loss grows by the premise Accrues, share and rule only do not fall. favours, the selection, mind and the loss are parameters.
findings.howFarSeen: File lines 1-335 and 396-520 read whole (statements and module account, proofs skimmed); the rest (Drawn, Thinned) by declaration heads and the module account only. Raises, ReadsShare, Locked read in RuleCapture.lean lines 145-161.

He does not say what cannot turn; what he sets against it is 'actually seeing the situation as they are'. The survey brief's telling ('what the account leaves out is used up') is not in his messages of 14:53 or 15:03.

findings.finding: What a theorem would have to state for the 18 November picture, as outcomes of one course and not premises: (1) an account, read off the registered part alone, that is false at some configuration reached (ClosedCapture's reading Q says nothing of what lies beyond); (2) a holder and its held-to generated from the account, not handed in as favours or a target; (3) the holder's own revising keeps the account though it is false; (4) acting from it draws on what it does not register no less as the holder's share rises, and what would revise it goes with what is drawn. Pieces exist apart (reading_absorbed; fixed_of_closedFrom; LumpedSeeking.seeking_keeps_order; PoolFromCourse.window_order_kept; ReadingsPersist.cleared_removes_its_readers; ReadingsSpread.Commons; ReflexivePrediction); none was found joined. That anyone is in such a course no theorem gives.
